description: Engineering Council  Sri Lanka - Engineering Council,  Sri Lanka Rules
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made by the Engineering Council under Section 39 of the Engineering Council, Sri Lanka Act No. 4 of 2017. It establishes regulatory frameworks for the registration of engineering practitioners, maintenance of registers, and use of the official seal. This content falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation that create compliance requirements for engineering professionals.
